description:
Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client

The Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client. Chat freely, create boldly, and bring ideas to life.
Linux arm64 packages are now available as AppImage and deb, with in-app update support.
Mobile access gains command directory, file search, attachment upload, voice transcription, and session model or reasoning adjustments.
Mobile sessions mirror desktop content with streaming updates, permission prompts, approvals, and answers.
Voice editing now supports multi-turn context, partial replacement, and on-demand reading of long text.
Skills display both their display name and skill name across the skills page and input menu.
Performance improvements for a smoother experience.
Fixed several known issues.
source: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
